requirements.statement: Bind Stage 2 to the exact PR 10 squash commit, tree, parent, exact-head CI, and post-merge main CI.
Verify every inherited Part 1 authority at its Stage 1 SHA-256 digest.
Implement the oracle in a separate package with no production reconciliation, Spark, AWS, persistence, or network import.
Forbid production modules from importing the reference oracle and forbid authoritative output emission.
Independently implement strict JSON, NFC, timestamp, digest, source identity, replay, conflict, and derived identity rules.
Independently implement checked signed 64-bit arithmetic with fail-admission overflow behavior.
Calculate transaction-grain signs, references, capacity, journal meaning, counts, totals, deltas, status, and reasons.
Calculate settlement formula, exact allocation, no-double-use, account policy, counts, three deltas, status, and reasons.
Preserve missing evidence independently from zero value and prevent tolerance from hiding semantic failure.
Calculate comparison-ready proof, case, and revision identities without persisting or finalizing authoritative output.
Return no authoritative proof expectation for admission or execution failure.
Cover all frozen examples, eighteen invariants, twenty-one behavioral scenarios, coherence vectors, and the complete reason taxonomy.
Reject targeted semantic mutants and pass deterministic boundary, permutation, and metamorphic tests.
Produce equal candidate evidence from at least two exact Python 3.11.13 clean runs with hash-locked dependencies.
Require exact-head draft-PR CI, immutable evidence inspection, squash merge, and independent main CI before gate promotion.
